title: Overview
description: The whole stack at a glance. Each section links to its own dashboard.

panels.title: Online now
panels.description: Devices that talked to the backend in the last 15 minutes.

panels.title: Students
panels.description: Active users signed in with a student ID.

panels.title: Re-login needed
panels.description: NTUST accounts whose stored credential stopped working. Their server-side sync is paused until they sign in again.

panels.title: Scrape targets
panels.description: Whether Prometheus reached each exporter on its last scrape. backend DOWN means the API process is down or its metrics port is closed.

panels.title: App errors, 1h
panels.description: Error and critical log lines from the backend, portal and Postgres in the last hour. The Logs dashboard has every container.

panels.title: Push delay
panels.description: How late the most overdue pending push is. Climbing means the push tick is stuck.

panels.title: Sync overdue
panels.description: Pending sync jobs more than 10 minutes past their run time.

panels.title: Bulletin scrape
panels.description: Since a scrape last read at least one bulletin off the list page. Failed scrapes are not counted, nor ones whose page parsed to nothing (the board always lists something, so that means the markup changed). The scraper runs every 10 minutes by default; right after a backend restart this counts from the restart.

panels.title: Push jobs finished per hour
panels.description: Rolling one-hour count, sampled every 30 seconds.

panels.title: Errors and warnings: backend, portal, Postgres
